column3: “porpoise skins” renders “tahash skins,” an animal whose identity is uncertain.
“a mercy seat” renders “kapporet,” the atonement cover (also in verses 18–22).
“facing one another” renders “their faces each to its brother.”
“I will give you in commandment” renders “I will command you.”
“with which to pour libations” renders “with which it will be poured out.”
“the bread of the Presence” renders “bread of the face,” and “at all times” renders “continually.”
